summary: Heaviest single-session closure count since inception: four stops triggered by Thursday's $797B Mag-7 rout (TSLA -12.1%, GOOGL -3.1%, META -4.6%, SMCI thesis_broken on stale entry data) partially offset by INTC T1 hit (+10.9% on Q2 blowout with DCAI +59%) and XLE T2 hit (+16.3% with Brent above $100).
